messages:
Ellie (Support): 🚨 Escalation from AcmeCorp — they report ~2.3x median latency increase on /v1/generate-prod since ~2024-06-07 09:00 UTC. Dedicated pool: dc-us-west-2. 90th percentile is spiking, customer hitting SLO. APM trace: https://apm.redwood/example/trace/0xabc. Can eng-runtime take a look?
Maya Chen: Thanks — can you paste a sample request id + model variant? Also, did they see errors or throttling?
Ellie (Support): Sample request id: 84f2c1a7. Model: rdx/gpt-medium-2024-06-rc1 (quantized). No 5xxs reported, just higher tail latency. I've opened ticket RW-9831 and attached trace.
Ivan Petrov: I'll grab flamegraphs from the dedicated pool. Can someone run a synthetic perf-run against dc-us-west-2 using their model so we can reproduce?
Liam O'Neill: I'll run a quick benchmark now. Command I'm using:
```bash
perf-bench --target dc-us-west-2 --model rdx/gpt-medium-2024-06-rc1 --qps 20 --duration 300 --payload-size 512
```
Liam O'Neill: (run output) baseline median=45ms p95=120ms p99=270ms --> after suspected window median=98ms p95=280ms p99=640ms. Reproducible locally on pool.
Priya Rao: Can we check KV cache hit rate and batching stats? If prefix caching dropped, we'd see higher token compute. Also check any recent kernel/driver updates on those hosts.
Rob: I noticed a canary rollout yesterday at 03:10 UTC that bumped the runtime to kernel v2.14. @deploy-bot can you confirm which hosts got the rollout in dc-us-west-2?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout rdx-runtime-v2.14 applied to hosts: usw2-rt-34, usw2-rt-35, usw2-rt-36 at 2024-06-07T03:10:22Z. No automatic rollback triggered.
Ivan Petrov: Good catch. I'll run perf traces on usw2-rt-34 and compare to usw2-rt-31 (older kernel). Also pulling perf counters and flamegraphs now.
Maya Chen: I'll correlate customer traces with our telemetry (batch sizes, KV hits, kernel scheduler delays). Ellie, can you ask AcmeCorp to share a small set of representative requests if they're OK? That helps reproduce exactly.
Ellie (Support): On it — they said they'll send 10 representative requests and sample responses. ETA ~30m.
Ivan Petrov: Early flamegraph shows ~40% more time in attention kernel on v2.14 hosts vs v2.12. Attn-kernel allocations also show heavier cache misses. Suspect kernel change or a SIMD codepath regression.
Priya Rao: If it's kernel-level, fallback plan: roll back the canary on the affected hosts or pin dedicated pool to v2.12. Rob, can we schedule a rollback for usw2-rt-34..36?
Rob: I can roll them back. Rolling back now for immediate relief. Will update here when hosts are back to v2.12.
Rob: Rolled back usw2-rt-34..36 to v2.12 at 2024-06-07T11:02:14Z. Monitoring metrics.
Liam O'Neill: After rollback, quick bench shows median=48ms p95=125ms p99=280ms — back to normal range.
Ellie (Support): Confirmed AcmeCorp reports improvement in the last 10 minutes. They're still in the ticket but pleased.
Maya Chen: Action items: (1) Ivan to file a perf regression PR and attach flamegraphs + perf counters, (2) Priya to triage kernel diff and reproduce minimal repro, (3) Rob to coordinate a mitigation policy so future canaries don't hit dedi pools without staged autoscaling.
Ivan Petrov: Filed perf regression issue RW-9840 with artifacts.
Priya Rao: I'll reproduce locally and open a follow-up with kernel vendor if needed.
Ellie (Support): Thanks team — I'll update customer and close escalation once RW-9840 has owner and ETA. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Nice fast triage. Marking this resolved in-channel for now. If anything reappears, ping #incidents.
